subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving paid plan activations for {Brand} in the markets where you sell. The one point worth restating: we optimize to the paid plan activation and read it back through the carrier billing and provisioning backend, so spend lands on a paid, network-activated line once the eSIM downloads or the SIM comes up, never on an abandoned SIM order. At scale that runs around 2,200 validated activations a day for us. If it helps, I can pull the plan-level activation view for your footprint. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate paid plan activation validation proof
illustrative_flags: 2,200 validated activations a day (MobUpps daily paid plan activation volume, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN telecom: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (paid plan activation optimized + validated via carrier billing/provisioning backend, eSIM SM-DP+/physical SIM); one illustrative MobUpps figure (2,200 activations/day, flagged); soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; native EN; no X-not-Y, no em-dash.
